hook.situation: A learner can read dictionary forms like 춥다, 듣다, 모르다, and 빨갛다, but the real spoken forms are 추워요, 들어요, 몰라요, and 빨개요. This chapter turns those shape changes into usable habits.
objectives: Match high-frequency dictionary forms with their real polite forms.
Separate true irregular stems from regular lookalikes such as 닫다 and 웃다.
Use irregular forms inside natural sentences about weather, food, health, walking, listening, knowing, and colors.
hook.whyItMatters: If a learner says 춥어요 or 듣어요, the meaning may be understandable, but the sentence immediately sounds broken. Irregulars are not rare grammar trivia; they appear in the first hundred everyday sentences a learner wants to say.

grammarNotes.title: ㅂ irregular — ㅂ becomes 우/오 before vowel endings
grammarNotes.mentalModel: When a vowel-starting ending arrives, many ㅂ-final descriptive words soften their final sound: 춥다 does not become 춥어요; it becomes 추워요.
grammarNotes.formation: Drop ㅂ and add 우 before the ending: 춥다 → 추워요, 덥다 → 더워요, 어렵다 → 어려워요. A small exception group uses 오: 돕다 → 도와요, 곱다 → 고와요.
exceptions: Not every ㅂ-final word changes. 입다 is regular: 입어요.
돕다 and 곱다 use 오 before 아/어: 도와요, 고와요.

grammarNotes.title: ㄷ irregular — ㄷ becomes ㄹ in a small verb set
grammarNotes.mentalModel: Only memorize the common verbs that actually change. 듣다 and 걷다 change, but 닫다, 받다, and 믿다 stay regular.
grammarNotes.formation: For ㄷ-irregular verbs, ㄷ changes to ㄹ before a vowel-starting ending: 듣다 → 들어요, 걷다 → 걸어요, 묻다(to ask) → 물어요.

examples.en: I listen to music every morning.
I walk in the park after work.
If you do not know, ask the teacher.

examples.note: 닫다 is regular, so ㄷ does not change.

exceptions: 묻다 meaning 'to ask' changes to 물어요, but 묻다 meaning 'to bury' or 'to get on/stain' can be regular in many uses.
닫다, 받다, 믿다, 얻다 are regular lookalikes.

grammarNotes.title: ㅅ irregular — ㅅ drops before vowel endings
grammarNotes.mentalModel: Some ㅅ-final stems lose ㅅ completely when a vowel ending comes. The important learner trap is that common regular verbs like 웃다 and 씻다 do not drop it.
grammarNotes.formation: Drop ㅅ before a vowel-starting ending: 낫다 → 나아요, 짓다 → 지어요, 잇다 → 이어요/이어, 붓다 → 부어요.

examples.en: I hope you get better quickly.

examples.note: 웃다 is regular, so ㅅ stays.

exceptions: 웃다, 씻다, 벗다 are regular. Say 웃어요, 씻어요, 벗어요.
Do not write 낫아요. The correct form is 나아요.

grammarNotes.title: 르 irregular — add ㄹ to the previous syllable
grammarNotes.mentalModel: 르 verbs do not simply attach 아요/어요. The ㄹ doubles back onto the previous syllable: 모르다 becomes 몰라요, not 모르어요.
grammarNotes.formation: Before 아요/어요, drop 으 from 르 and add ㄹ to the previous syllable: 모르다 → 몰라요, 다르다 → 달라요, 부르다 → 불러요, 자르다 → 잘라요.

examples.en: I do not know that person's name.
The two colors are a little different.

exceptions: Do not confuse 르-irregular stems with ㄹ-final stems. 살다 ends in ㄹ and becomes 살아요, not 사라요.
르 irregular is mainly triggered by 아요/어요-type endings.

grammarNotes.title: ㅎ irregular — colors and demonstratives change shape
grammarNotes.mentalModel: Many color adjectives and demonstratives lose ㅎ and change the vowel: 빨갛다 becomes 빨개요, 어떻다 becomes 어때요.
grammarNotes.formation: Before -아/어요, ㅎ drops and the ending combines into 애요/에요-like forms: 빨갛다 → 빨개요, 파랗다 → 파래요, 노랗다 → 노래요, 하얗다 → 하얘요, 어떻다 → 어때요, 그렇다 → 그래요.

examples.en: The sky is really blue today.
You can do it that way.
examples.note: 그렇다 appears in forms like 그래요 and 그렇게.

exceptions: 좋다 and 많다 do not follow this color/demonstrative pattern: 좋아요, 많아요.
Before noun-modifying -(으)ㄴ, learn the common forms as chunks: 빨간 사과, 파란 하늘, 어떤 방법.

grammarNotes.title: ㄹ deletion — ㄹ drops before ㄴ, ㅂ, and ㅅ endings
grammarNotes.mentalModel: ㄹ-final stems are predictable. Keep ㄹ before vowel endings, but drop it before endings like -는, -ㅂ니다, and -세요.
grammarNotes.formation: 알다 → 알아요, but 알다 + -세요 → 아세요, 알다 + -ㅂ니다 → 압니다, 알다 + -는 → 아는. 살다 works the same way: 살아요, 사세요, 삽니다, 사는.
exceptions: This pattern is often listed with irregulars, but it is highly predictable.
Do not remove ㄹ before every ending. 알아요 and 살아요 keep ㄹ.

exampleSentence.en: It is easier than I thought.
I listen to music every morning.
I walk in the park after work.
If you do not know, ask the teacher.
I do not know that person's name.
The two colors are a little different.

extendedDialogue.setting: A learner asks why common words change shape in polite speech.

lines.speaker: 민서
lines.ko: 오늘 너무 추워요. 그런데 왜 '춥어요'가 아니에요?
lines.romanization: oneul neomu chuwoyo. geureonde wae 'chupeoyo'ga anieyo?
lines.en: It is so cold today. But why isn't it '춥어요'?
lines.grammarNote: 춥다 follows the ㅂ irregular, so the natural form is 추워요.

lines.speaker: 지훈
lines.ko: 춥다처럼 ㅂ으로 끝나는 말은 추워요, 더워요처럼 바뀌어요.
lines.romanization: chupdacheoreom bieubeuro kkeutnaneun mareun chuwoyo, deowoyo-cheoreom bakkwieoyo.
lines.en: Words ending in ㅂ, like 춥다, change to forms like 추워요 and 더워요.
lines.grammarNote: The pair is more useful than the label: 춥다/추워요, 덥다/더워요.

lines.speaker: 민서
lines.ko: 그럼 듣다는 들어요, 걷다는 걸어요가 맞죠?
lines.romanization: geureom deutdaneun deureoyo, geotdaneun georeoyoga matjyo?
lines.en: Then 듣다 becomes 들어요, and 걷다 becomes 걸어요, right?
lines.grammarNote: ㄷ changes to ㄹ in common verbs like 듣다 and 걷다.

lines.speaker: 지훈
lines.ko: 맞아요. 모르다는 몰라요, 빨갛다는 빨개요처럼 익히면 돼요.
lines.romanization: majayo. moreudaneun mollayo, ppalgataneun ppalgaeyo-cheoreom ikhimyeon dwaeyo.
lines.en: Right. Learn them as pairs, like 모르다 to 몰라요 and 빨갛다 to 빨개요.
lines.grammarNote: 르 and ㅎ irregulars are easier when memorized through common pairs.

lines.speaker: 민서
lines.en: Got it. I will memorize the high-frequency words first.
lines.grammarNote: 알다 keeps ㄹ in 알아요, but drops it in forms like 아세요 and 압니다.

readingText.title: 사전형과 말할 때의 모양
readingText.body: 한국어 사전에는 춥다, 듣다, 모르다처럼 기본형이 나오지만, 실제 대화에서는 추워요, 들어요, 몰라요처럼 바뀐 모양을 더 자주 들어요. 그래서 불규칙 활용은 시험용 표가 아니라 일상 발음과 문장을 바로잡는 도구예요. '오늘 추워요', '음악을 들어요', '저는 잘 몰라요', '이 방법은 어때요?' 같은 문장을 먼저 익히면 규칙 이름도 자연스럽게 따라와요. 단, 비슷하게 생겼다고 모두 바뀌지는 않아요. 듣다는 들어요지만 닫다는 닫아요이고, 낫다는 나아요지만 웃다는 웃어요예요.
readingText.bodyTranslation: Korean dictionaries show base forms such as 춥다, 듣다, and 모르다, but real conversation uses changed forms such as 추워요, 들어요, and 몰라요. Irregular conjugation is not just a test table; it repairs everyday pronunciation and sentences. Learn useful sentences first, then attach the rule names. Also remember that lookalikes are not always irregular: 듣다 changes to 들어요, but 닫다 stays 닫아요; 낫다 changes to 나아요, but 웃다 stays 웃어요.

comprehensionQuestions.question: 사전에는 어떤 모양이 나오지만 실제 대화에서는 어떤 모양을 더 자주 들어요?
comprehensionQuestions.answer: 사전에는 춥다, 듣다, 모르다 같은 기본형이 나오지만 실제 대화에서는 추워요, 들어요, 몰라요 같은 활용형을 더 자주 들어요.

comprehensionQuestions.question: 듣다와 닫다는 어떻게 달라요?
comprehensionQuestions.answer: 듣다는 들어요로 바뀌지만 닫다는 닫아요로 그대로 활용해요.

comprehensionQuestions.question: 불규칙 활용은 왜 일상 대화에 중요해요?
comprehensionQuestions.answer: 추워요, 들어요, 몰라요 같은 매우 자주 쓰는 문장에 바로 들어가기 때문이에요.

culturalNote.title: Learn the spoken form, not only the dictionary form
culturalNote.body: Korean learners often study dictionary forms first because that is how apps and dictionaries organize words. Native conversation, however, usually gives you the conjugated shape. If you only memorize 춥다 and 듣다, you may hesitate when you need 추워요 and 들어요. Treat each high-frequency irregular as a pair: dictionary form plus the first sentence you would actually say.
culturalNote.tip: For each new irregular, memorize one real chunk: 추워요, 들어요, 나았어요, 몰라요, 어때요, 아세요.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which form correctly conjugates 춥다 in polite present speech?
inlineExercises.explanation: 춥다 follows the ㅂ irregular: ㅂ changes to 우 before 어요.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which pair shows the ㄷ irregular?
inlineExercises.explanation: 듣다 changes ㄷ to ㄹ. 닫다 and 받다 are regular.
ㅅ drops in 낫다 before a vowel-starting ending.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 르 irregular correctly?
inlineExercises.explanation: 모르다 becomes 몰라요: ㄹ doubles onto the previous syllable.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which form is natural for 어떻다?
inlineExercises.explanation: 어떻다 is a ㅎ irregular adjective: 어떻다 + 어요 → 어때요.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which sentence shows ㄹ deletion before -세요?
inlineExercises.explanation: 알다 keeps ㄹ in 알아요 but drops ㄹ before -세요: 아세요.

bullets: ㄷ irregular: 듣다→들어요, 걷다→걸어요, but 닫다→닫아요.
ㅅ irregular: 낫다→나아요, 짓다→지어요, but 웃다→웃어요.
ㅎ irregular: 빨갛다→빨개요, 어떻다→어때요, but 좋다→좋아요.
